description: This file defines a PHP class `AM_ProjectTemplatesViewGanttChart` which extends `ViewDetail`. The class is responsible for rendering a Gantt chart view for project templates within the SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for displaying the view, loading related resources, and generating HTML and JavaScript for the Gantt chart interface, task pop-ups, and project creation dialogs.

classes.name: AM_ProjectTemplatesViewGanttChart
classes.description: A class for rendering the Gantt chart view of project templates, including tasks management and resource linking.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates HTML and JavaScript for displaying the Gantt chart interface, including resource retrieval and task pop-up modal dialogs.

methods.name: time_range
methods.description: Calculates and returns the duration between two dates in months and days.
